name: manual_4ed064
claim: Retain prewarm authentication failures until an under-lock durable clock observation commits, then refuse without retrying verification; deferring only errors raised inside the transaction leaves an observation gap.

decisions.notes: The C6 prewarm once-raising resolver regression initially left the clock unchanged; the fix records forward time and preserves the refusal.

rationale: The C6 prewarm once-raising resolver regression initially left the clock unchanged; the fix records forward time and preserves the refusal.
